example_sentences_in_bangla: মশা তাড়াতে গিয়ে সে নিজের গালে চড় মারল।
ভুল করার পর গালে চড় খেয়ে সে শিক্ষা নিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He tried to swat a mosquito and ended up slapping his own cheek.
After making a mistake, he got a slap in the face and learned his lesson.
history: This idiom originates from the Bengali proverb illustrating 'as you sow, so shall you reap,' where attempting to swat a mosquito results in accidentally slapping one's own cheek, symbolizing unintended painful consequences from one's actions.
note: Often used to describe self-inflicted mishaps leading to regret or learning.
